name: ferroui
description: FerroUI XAML and RSX design, native hot reload, and MCP tools for VS Code.

commands.title: Run and Debug with Hot Reload

enumDescriptions: Place attributes on the same line as the element name.
Place each attribute on its own line.
Place attributes on separate lines when the start tag exceeds Wrap Column.
ferroui.xaml.formatting.attributeLayout.description: Choose how Format Document and Format Selection lay out XAML attributes.

ferroui.xaml.formatting.wrapColumn.description: Start-tag width for the Wrap attribute layout, including its indentation.

ferroui.xaml.formatting.closingBracketOn.description: Place the closing bracket of a wrapped start tag on its own line.

ferroui.xaml.formatting.selfClosingSpace.description: Choose spacing before a self-closing XAML bracket on the same line.

ferroui.xaml.formatting.preserveBlankLin.description: Keep existing blank lines between XAML elements.

ferroui.mcp.enableDesigner.description: Offer the current VS Code designer workspace as a FerroUI MCP server.

ferroui.mcp.allowWrites.description: Allow agents to edit editor buffers, control designer views, or run an application through the VS Code designer MCP server.

ferroui.scenarios.baselineRef.description: Optional local Git reference for visual scenario review. The review uses the merge-base images and verifies the worktree baseline.

ferroui.mcp.stdioServers.description: Existing FerroUI application or Designer Studio MCP servers started by VS Code.

command.description: Absolute path to the native FerroUI executable.

args.description: Arguments such as --mcp-stdio and optional native permission flags.

ferroui.hotReload.cargoPath.description: Path to the Cargo executable used by Run with Hot Reload. Leave empty to use Cargo from PATH.

ferroui.hotReload.registeredSupervisor.description: Workspace-relative owning supervisor for registered Rust patch and state-restoration sessions.

ferroui.hotReload.pythonPath.description: Python executable for the registered patch supervisor.

ferroui.hotReload.patchCompilerPath.description: Path to the supervisor's pinned dx patch compiler. Leave empty to use PATH.

ferroui.hotReload.targets.description: Cargo binaries offered by Run with Hot Reload. An empty list discovers binaries from Cargo.toml.

manifestPath.description: Path to Cargo.toml relative to the workspace folder.

features.description: Cargo features. The package's hot-reload feature is enabled by default when present.

ferroui.languageServer.path.description: Absolute path to ferroui-xaml-lsp. Leave empty to use the bundled binary or PATH.

ferroui.collaboration.bindAddress.description: Loopback IP and port of newly hosted rooms. Leave empty for an available local port.

ferroui.collaboration.publicEndpoint.description: Optional HTTPS MCP endpoint advertised for new hosted rooms behind a TLS reverse proxy.

ferroui.preview.path.description: Absolute path to ferroui-designer-preview. Leave empty to use the bundled binary or PATH.

ferroui.rsx.completion.description: Offer FerroUI property names at mapped RSX fields alongside Rust completions.

ferroui.hostedPreview.assembly.description: Registered markup assembly for application previews. By default, use the selected Cargo package name.

ferroui.rsx.inlayHints.description: Show FerroUI types at RSX fields whose values can be edited in the designer.

ferroui.types.description: Custom XAML type and property metadata for the FerroUI language server.
